raw_entities.name: Customer Identification and KYC Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's formal policy governing customer identification and Know Your Customer verification processes. Version 2.0 effective 2026-03-01, owned by Head of Compliance and applicable across Retail Banking, Compliance, Financial Crime, and Operations functions. Mandates identity and address verification obligations for all customer accounts and products.
context: FirstUK Bank — Customer Identification and KYC Policy

raw_entities.description: Financial Conduct Authority regulatory framework governing conduct of business requirements, including customer identification and KYC obligations. This is the primary regulatory basis for FirstUK Bank's Customer Identification and KYC Policy.

raw_entities.name: Head of Compliance
raw_entities.description: The designated policy owner responsible for the Customer Identification and KYC Policy. Accountable for policy governance, maintenance, and compliance oversight across the bank.
